it: \rSalve! Benvenuto al Centro Commerciale di Hau'oli.

id: \bSophocles: Finally you show up. I'm giving you the honor of going into my secret space.
en: \bSophocles: Finally you show up. I'm giving you the honor of going into my secret space.
it: \bChrys: Finalmente ti fai vedere. Ti concedo l'onore di entrare nel mio spazio segreto.

id: \bOnly those who can hack the door are allowed in. However, I'm feeling generous and figured I'd show it to you. Ready to go in?
en: \bOnly those who can hack the door are allowed in.  However, I'm feeling generous and figured I'd show it to you. Ready to go in?
it: \bPossono entrare solo quelli che sanno hackerare la porta.  Però oggi mi sento generoso e ho pensato di mostrartelo. Pronto a entrare?

id: Rotom Dex: That was fun. Maybe we should head to the school now.
en: Rotom Dex: That was fun. Maybe we should head to the school now.
it: Rotom Dex: È stato divertente. Forse dovremmo andare a scuola adesso.

id: \rJessie: Did someone ask something? We're here to find out!
en: \rJessie: Did someone ask something? We're here to find out!
it: \rJessie: Qualcuno ha fatto una domanda? Siamo qui per scoprirlo!

id: \bJames: Noble answers are what we're all about!
en: \bJames: Noble answers are what we're all about!
it: \bJames: Risposte nobili sono la nostra specialità!

id: \rJessie: The beauty so radiant, the flowers and moon hide in shame. A single flower of evil in this fleeting world: Jessie!
en: \rJessie: The beauty so radiant, the flowers and moon hide in shame. A single flower of evil in this fleeting world: Jessie!
it: \rJessie: Una bellezza così radiosa che fiori e luna si nascondono per la vergogna. Unico fiore del male in questo mondo effimero: Jessie!

id: \bJames: The nobly heroic man of our times! The master of darkness fighting back against a tragic world! It's James.
en: \bJames: The nobly heroic man of our times! The master of darkness fighting back against a tragic world! It's James.
it: \bJames: L'uomo nobile ed eroico dei nostri tempi! Il signore delle tenebre che si ribella a un mondo tragico! Ecco James.

id: \bMeowth: It's all for one and one for all! A glittering dark star that always shines bright! Dig it, while Meowth still takes flight!
en: \bMeowth: It's all for one and one for all! A glittering dark star that always shines bright! Dig it, while Meowth still takes flight!
it: \bMeowth: Tutti per uno e uno per tutti! Una scintillante stella oscura che brilla sempre forte! Tenetevi forte, Meowth spicca il volo!
